name: Maximum Level Sum with Distinct Nonsingleton Fibers
definition: Use Hamming-weight maximum sequences on two old and three control coordinates with changed levels $k=s=1$. Over the two words of $A_1\setminus A_0$, use fibers $F_1=\{0,1,3,5\}$ and $F_2=\{0,2,3,6\}$ in binary integer notation.
properties: The two old words lie in separate $G_1$ components. Both fibers are maximum trees, contain $B_0=\{0\}$, and lie in $B_2=\{0,1\}^3\setminus\{7\}$. The replacement criterion gives a maximum rank-two class on five coordinates with 16 words and two distinct nonsingleton fibers.
